The '''Nerrif system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Vilonis sector/Legends|Vilonis sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and contained the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] of [[Nerrif]].
